name: Tislit
description: Star of 6,400 K, 343 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-161 b crosses Tislit as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Barkaoui et al. 2019.

quotes.title: WASP-161
quotes.card: WASP-161, also named Tislit, is an F-type main-sequence star about 1,162 light-years away in the constellation Puppis.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent magnitude of 11.1, it is much too faint to be visible to the naked eye.
